scope: fixed published single-position FamilyCode prediction on released homeodomain mutant PBM matrices; no model fitting or tuning
prospective_boundary: Protocol fixed before computing predictions or performance in this local evaluation. Public outcomes, source QC and publication were already inspectable; this is not a blinded preregistered experiment.

accounting.purpose: complete accounting; no exclusions may disappear

primary.eligibility: original SD3 reference/mutant peptide pair; one exact amino-acid edit consistent with label; one unique named original domain row matching every non-gap reference clone column at canonical-minus-one coordinates

excluded_primary.reason: older variants without recovered original clone peptide pair; not a quality or measured-effect exclusion

secondary_metadata.purpose: descriptive evaluation of every older provenance-limited variant using original first-row domain plus metadata edit after old-residue validation; not clone-confirmed and never contributes to primary acceptance
secondary_metadata.mapping_failure: explicit unsupported status with reason; do not repair from outcomes
secondary_metadata.metrics: same two endpoints, all replicates, WT means and tied-nearest baseline rules; aggregate separately with equal weight across its8factors; report descriptive factor bootstrap using the same algorithm and seed with its own sorted factor list; no acceptance threshold

model.row_order: original one-based order; preserve duplicate names and values
model.reference_and_mutant_queries: same actual clone-derived domain map and mutation column; only the source-verified residue differs
model.algorithm: published makeSVDModel.singleMutation special case; conditional means of sum-normalized motif columns plus pinned BLOSUM interpolation; output per-column maximum one and floor0.01
model.executed_implementation: exact evidence/binding.py with pinned homeodomain.json and BLOSUM62.json; fail if bytes differ; later evaluator identity must also be recorded
model.original_R_parity: unavailable; independent algebra/SVD parity is distinct

observations.orientation: original released matrix orientation and fixed column labels, without shift or reverse-complement optimization
observations.assay_boundary: released ProBound log-weight fits to PBM signals; not raw fluorescence, absolute Kd, or independently verified preparation counts
observations.mutant_replicates: all available released matrices per eligible variant, regardless of source probe-fit R2; retain single-matrix cases
observations.reference_replicates: all available released WT matrices for that factor
observations.missingness: retain exclusions and absent second replicate as unavailable, never numerical zero
observations.source_QC: published probe-fit R2 and quality-ranked first/second samples are retained as metadata only; no new QC threshold
observations.WT_reference_log_order: center log of each separately prepared WT matrix, then average; do not center log of the arithmetic mean

no_effect_WT_raw.matrix: arithmetic mean of all separately prepared measured WT PSAMs of the same factor
no_effect_WT_raw.information: has measured WT information; explicitly stronger information access than an entirely sequence-only baseline

nearest_other_training_domain_raw.query: clone-extracted primary mutant domain; metadata-constructed first-row domain for provenance-limited secondary
nearest_other_training_domain_raw.distance: unweighted Hamming mismatch over all57 aligned columns; gaps count as characters
nearest_other_training_domain_raw.exclude: all casefold-equal target-factor names and all exact target-WT alignment copies
nearest_other_training_domain_raw.ties: use every equally nearest remaining source row; arithmetic mean of individually max-normalized/floored source motifs
nearest_other_training_domain_raw.source_motif_preparation: Q[b,c] = max(0.01, A[b,c] / max_a A[a,c]); reject nonfinite/negative values or a nonpositive column maximum
nearest_other_training_domain_raw.evidence: explicit excluded rows/reasons, minimum distance and all tied source rows in variant-mapping.json

mutation_contrast.prediction: C(model mutant PSAM) - C(model reference PSAM), using the same mutation column and frozen model
mutation_contrast.target: C(empirical mutant PSAM) - arithmetic_mean_over_WT_replicates C(empirical WT PSAM)
mutation_contrast.replicate_loss: mean over32 entries of (predicted contrast - measured contrast)^2
mutation_contrast.units: dimensionless centered-log relative preference contrast, not measured physical energy or absolute affinity

order: mean all mutant replicates within variant
mean27primary or8secondary factors with equal within-cohort factor weights; never pool them for acceptance
aggregation.paired_improvement: baseline loss minus model loss; positive favors model
aggregation.WT_dependence: WT matrices are shared references, not additional independent target or replicate counts
required_outputs: raw residuals32 per mutant replicate per endpoint
per-replicate losses for model and each relevant baseline
per-variant and per-factor losses and paired differences
source row corrections and BLOSUM interpolation flags
all matrix source identities and denominators

uncertainty.method: paired nonparametric factor-cluster bootstrap; keep all variants, replicates and shared WT references together
uncertainty.generator: Python3.11 random.Random(seed); for each resample draw len(factors) indices with randrange(len(factors)); reuse each index vector for all comparisons
uncertainty.interval: two-sided95percentile interval, endpoints0.025 and0.975; linear interpolation at q*(B-1) in sorted bootstrap means
uncertainty.additional_sensitivity: report leave-one-factor-out point-improvement range and factor-level improvement signs; not an acceptance override
uncertainty.interpretation: conditional on this finite factor panel, fixed training model and released assay preparation; does not propagate model-training or independent-preparation uncertainty

acceptance.criterion: lower endpoint of each paired factor-bootstrap95percentile interval for baseline-minus-model MSE is strictly greater than0
acceptance.boundary: This is an assay-relative comparative-prediction criterion, not evidence of practical adequacy, new-factor holdout, endogenous gene regulation or neural development. Failure of any comparison keeps predictive acceptance failed; software correctness may still pass.

secondary_only.paper_regularized_contrast: optional separately labeled estimator with exact best-quality WT references and source regularization; not the primary centered-log contrast or physical delta energy
secondary_only.paper_groupedR2: optional association statistic refits a through-origin slope and clamps some cases; not fixed-prediction R2
secondary_only.literal_first_row: retain original first-row mapping for all92 in the audit; mandatory26variant secondary uses it, while14primary clone-informed row corrections are explicit; no90case optional replay is required
secondary_only.stratifications: clone-supported source corrections, BLOSUM interpolation and factor-wise outcomes may be reported descriptively without new acceptance thresholds or replacing the primary endpoint

failure_policy.invalid_input: fail evaluation closed before metrics; preserve error, offending variant and original bytes
failure_policy.unsupported_primary_case: do not shrink frozen primary cohort after seeing outcomes; mark benchmark incomplete and preserve existing predictions as partial if any
failure_policy.postfreeze_change: new protocol version plus diff and reason; retain old freeze; no retrospective replacement of failed primary result

limitations: SD3 supplies clone amino-acid sequences and mutagenesis primers, not complete individual assayed DNA haplotypes
26 older variants lack recovered original clone-pair provenance
training includes WT factors and related domains, so this is mutant intervention evaluation, not new-factor holdout
both mutant and training PSAMs are fitted assay summaries with fixed normalization and clipping
five clone-report versus released-matrix replicate-count differences remain stage-provenance ambiguity
17 supplied downstream full-protein FASTA labels disagree with sequence residue and are not primary input
no authenticated original R mutant-output oracle was recovered
binding preference does not justify an unmeasured mapping into expression, fate, neurite growth or intelligence
